messages.subject: Installing PyStan Behind Firewall
parts:
Any idea how to install PyStan behind a corporate firewall? I already had Anaconda and then installed Visual Studio 2008 Express.

I tried modifying
conda install -c patricksnape pystan

to 
conda install -c patricksnape pystan -proxy="http://autoproxy:81"

but no luck.
